text: Hi, the kitchen tap in 4B will not stop dripping. I am home after 6pm.
I can smell gas in the hallway outside 2A. Please send someone now.
No heating in 7C since Monday. I work from home all week.
Sparks came out of the socket by my bed in 3D. I switched it off at the wall.
Locked out of 1A, keys are inside. I am standing at the door now.
The dishwasher in 5B leaks onto the floor. Mornings are best for me.
The hallway light in 6A flickers. Any weekday after 5pm is fine.
The boiler in 2B bangs when it starts. I am home Saturday morning.
Water is dripping through the ceiling in 8A next to the light fitting. I am out 9 to 5.
The front door of 3B will not close properly. Any time works.
The toilet keeps running all night. Can someone come this week?
We saw three mice in the kitchen of 4A yesterday.
El grifo del baño de 6B pierde agua. Estoy en casa por las tardes.
The radiator in 1B is cold and the bedroom is freezing. The kids are home all day.
The smoke alarm in 7A keeps chirping and I cannot reach it.
A pipe burst under the sink in 2C and water is everywhere. I have shut the stopcock.
